articles.title: Krisenprofite von Energieunternehmen: Wer jetzt am Irankrieg verdient
articles.teaser: Wenn der Ölpreis steigt, profitieren vor allem Vermögende. Neue Zahlen zeigen das Ausmaß dieser extremen Umverteilung. Es braucht eine Übergewinnsteuer.
articles.image_title: Krisenprofite von Energieunternehmen: CARSON, CALIFORNIA - MARCH 10: In an aerial view, Marathon Petroleum Corp's Los Angeles Refinery, one of the largest oil refineries in the North America, operates as gas prices rocket upward due to worldwide oil supply disruptions caused by the U.S. and Israeli attack on Iran, on March 10, 2026 in Carson, California. The heavy crude oil refining industry in California was already under increasing pressure before the war since the Phillips 66 refinery in Los Angeles officially shut down at the end of 2025. Valero's Oil refinery in Benicia, California is expected to add to those pressures when it fully shuts down at the end of next month. The national average gas price has risen to $3.54 and the average California gas price is currently $5.29, according to the American Automobile Association (AAA) today. (Photo by David McNew/Getty Images)
